verdict.rationale: LibreChat's beta Agent Management API says it authenticates machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities. That is a first-party credential mechanism for programmatic agent access with some binding, but the evidence never describes per-credential scopes or least-privilege permissions. missing for 10: documented scoped or least-privilege permission model for agent credentials, a credential issuance and revocation workflow, detail beyond a beta one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: authenticate machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities
